verdict.rationale: The evidence shows SES publishes sending events to SNS, EventBridge, CloudWatch, Firehose and Pinpoint. Nothing in the pack documents signed event payloads or signature-verification code for SES events. Any authenticity checking would rely on the host AWS delivery services, which the evidence does not cover and which would not count toward the product itself.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can verify webhook authenticity — signed payloads with documented signature verification code — so spoofed events can't poison my delivery state
